title: 第0358章 高考落幕成绩公布第0357章 并列前列双双晋级
content_zh:
凰溪岛武道中心，决战擂台之上。
漫天溃散的气血余波缓缓平息，擂台表面密密麻麻的裂痕还在微微发烫，刚刚那场血脉武道与心灵序列的极致碰撞，余威依旧笼罩全场。
贾黑米拄着微微发麻的双腿稳稳站定，粗重的喘息声在寂静的赛场中格外清晰。
浑身筋骨如同被重锤反复碾轧，三百赫的气血全力爆发，接连极限厮杀、硬碰血脉天赋，早已让他肉身负荷拉满，肌肉酸痛刺骨，丹田气血近乎枯竭。
反观对面的才依依，白衣依旧纤尘不染，身姿挺拔如松。
作为凰溪岛万年不遇的血脉天骄，她的根基、底蕴、天赋，本就甩开同级武者无数。方才全力以赴的巅峰对决，看似势均力敌，实则她全程留有余力，仅仅是被贾黑米的心灵破障天赋打乱了血脉节奏，被迫陷入平局拉扯。
清冷的眸光落在前方少年身上，才依依眼底第一次褪去了往日的淡然孤傲，多了几分真切的正视与讶异。
从集训初期人人鄙夷的气血废柴，到如今能与她正面硬刚、平分秋色的同级强者。
贾黑米的崛起速度，早已打破了凰溪岛所有人的认知。
“武道实战对决，无胜负、无输赢，双方战力持平，并列擂台前列！”
裁判长老洪亮的声音响彻整座武道中心，穿透所有喧嚣，敲定了这场万众瞩目的巅峰对决结果。
话音落下的瞬间，死寂一瞬的赛场，轰然爆发出震天热议！
“平局？！真的是平局！”
“我的天！贾黑米一个普通出身的序列武者，硬生生跟才依依打平了？”
“才依依可是血脉武者！同阶之内无敌的存在！往届高考从来都是碾压夺冠！”
“废柴逆袭到这种地步，这哪里是黑马，这简直是逆天改命！”
看台上，无数考生、家长、武道老师彻底沸腾。
此前所有人都认定，这一届高考状元，必定是才依依囊中之物，无人能抢、无人能挡。
没人看好气血起步孱弱、前期屡屡垫底的贾黑米。
可从预选赛一路逆袭，闯过层层厮杀，破解考场邪神渗透阴谋，最后在总决赛巅峰战平天骄，贾黑米用一场实打实的对决，打碎了所有偏见、所有质疑。

看台角落。
花呗呗晃着灵动的眸子，嘴角咧开大大的笑意，一手拍着身旁黑猫的脑袋，啧啧感慨：“可以啊黑米！藏得够深！三百赫气血硬拼血脉天赋，你这心灵序列，简直是所有天赋天骄的克星！”
猫和甩了甩漆黑的尾巴，幽绿色的竖瞳紧盯擂台，淡淡传音：“不是硬拼，是克制。心灵破障能紊乱精神、动摇气血、干扰血脉律动，才依依输在规则，不是输在实力。”
即便如此，能以二阶序列初期的境界，逼平顶级血脉天骄，放眼整个凰溪岛历年武道高考，都是前无古人的奇迹。
不远处，叶利西斜靠在观赛栏杆上，白发随风轻扬，一脸云淡风轻，眼底却藏着淡淡的欣慰。
他比任何人都清楚，贾黑米今日的平局，含金量有多恐怖。
才依依的上古封印血脉，自带心灵抗性，寻常心灵序列武者，别说干扰对决，就连靠近都会被血脉气场压制，根本无法催动能力。
贾黑米能做到极限拉扯、平分秋色，不止是天赋强横，更是心性、意志、战斗本能全方位碾压同级。
“小家伙，终于熬出头了。”叶利西低声呢喃。
从最初气血孱弱、被全岛嘲讽废柴，到一步步打磨肉身、淬炼气血、觉醒天赋、净化诡异，熬过无数冷眼、质疑、生死危机，今日终于站在了凰溪岛武道高考的最顶端。
擂台之上。
才依依缓缓收敛起周身沸腾的血色气血，一步步朝着擂台边缘走去。
路过贾黑米身侧时，她脚步微顿，清冷的嗓音不带胜负戾气，坦然开口：“你很强。”
这是她第一次主动认可同级对手。
从前的她，视所有同龄人为庸碌之辈，武道之路独行无忌，从未有人能逼她全力以赴，更无人能让她心生忌惮。
贾黑米抬眸，擦去额角冷汗，笑了笑：“侥幸而已，你留手了。”
他能清晰感知，方才对决的最后一瞬，对方的血脉绝杀随时可以落下，只是最终选择了收敛攻势，默认平局结果。
才依依侧眸看他，眸光澄澈：“武道对决，结果为尊。平局，便是你我今日的实力。”
说完，她不再多言，转身走下擂台，背影清冷孤傲，却再无半分居高临下的傲慢。
经此一战，凰溪岛两大天才，彻底齐名。

赛场中央，所有晋级考生依次列队，刚刚结束的巅峰对决，彻底画上**。
拖延多日的武道高考总决赛，历经邪神渗透、考场阴谋、联盟彻查、局势动荡，终于圆满落幕。
接下来，便是所有考生最紧张、最期待的环节——总成绩公示，名校录取开启。
武道高考的排名规则，从来不是单一实战成绩。
content_en:
Huangxi Island Martial Arts Center, on the decisive battle stage.
The aftermath of the dissipated energy and blood slowly subsided, and the dense cracks on the surface of the arena were still slightly hot. The residual power of the ultimate collision between bloodline martial arts and spiritual sequence just now still enveloped the entire place.
Jiahemi stood firmly with his slightly numb legs, and his heavy breathing was particularly clear in the silent arena.
The muscles and bones all over his body felt like they were repeatedly crushed by a heavy hammer. Three hundred kilohertz of energy and blood burst out with all their strength. The continuous extreme fighting and head-to-head encounters with bloodline talents had already strained his physical body. His muscles were sore and bone-piercing, and his Dantian energy and blood were almost exhausted.
On the other hand, looking at Cai Yiyi opposite, her white clothes are still spotless, and her posture is as tall as a pine tree.
As a rare genius of blood on Huangxi Island for thousands of years, her foundation, heritage, and talent are already far ahead of countless warriors at the same level. The peak duel in which she had just gone all out seemed to be evenly matched, but in fact she had some strength left throughout the whole process. It was just that Jia Heimi's talent of breaking mental barriers disrupted the blood rhythm and was forced into a draw.
The cold eyes fell on the young man in front of him, and for the first time, Yiyi's eyes lost the indifference and aloofness of the past, and became more serious and surprised.
From the weakling who was despised by everyone in the early days of training, to a strong man of the same level who can stand up to her head-on and compete with her now.
The speed of Jia Heimi's rise has already exceeded everyone's understanding on Huangxi Island.
"A practical martial arts duel, no winner or loser, no winner or loser, both sides have equal combat power and are tied at the front of the ring!"
The loud voice of the referee resounded throughout the martial arts center, cutting through all the noise and finalizing the outcome of this much-anticipated peak showdown.
The moment the words fell, the arena, which had been silent for a moment, suddenly erupted into heated discussions!
"A draw?! It's really a draw!"
"Oh my God! Jia Heimi, a serial warrior with an ordinary background, suddenly tied with Cai Yiyi?"
"Cai Yiyi is a bloodline warrior! Invincible within the same level! In previous college entrance examinations, he has always won the championship by crushing him!"
"How can a loser counterattack like this? How can he be a dark horse? This is simply a change of destiny!"
In the stands, countless candidates, parents, and martial arts teachers were completely excited.
Everyone had previously believed that the top scorer in this college entrance examination must be Cai Yiyi's bag, and no one could snatch it or stop him.
No one was optimistic about Jia Heimi, who had a weak start and was often at the bottom in the early stages.
But he counterattacked all the way from the qualifiers, fought through all the fights, cracked the evil infiltration conspiracy in the examination room, and finally tied with Tianjiao at the top of the finals. Jiahemi shattered all prejudices and doubts with a real duel.
Stand corner.
Hua Beibei swayed her smart eyes, grinned widely, patted the black cat next to her on the head with one hand, and sighed: "Okay, Heimi! Hid it deep enough! With three hundred herqi and blood, you have to fight for your bloodline talent. With your spiritual sequence, you are simply the nemesis of all talented geniuses!"
Mao He flicked his jet-black tail, staring at the ring with his dark green vertical pupils, and said faintly: "It's not about fighting hard, it's about restraint. Mind breaking can disrupt the spirit, shake the energy and blood, and interfere with the rhythm of the blood. Cai Yiyi loses because of the rules, not the strength."
Even so, being able to equal the top bloodline talent at the early stage of the second-order sequence is an unprecedented miracle, looking at the entire Huangxi Island martial arts college entrance examination over the years.
Not far away, Ye Lixi was leaning on the railing for watching the game, her white hair blowing gently in the wind, her face calm and relaxed, but there was a hint of relief in her eyes.
He knows better than anyone how terrifying the gold content of Jahimi's draw today is.
Cai Yiyi's ancient sealed bloodline has its own psychic resistance. For ordinary psychic sequence warriors, let alone interfering with the duel, even if they get close, they will be suppressed by the bloodline aura and unable to activate their abilities at all.
Jia Heimi is able to push and pull evenly to the extreme. Not only is he powerful in talent, but he also crushes his peers in all aspects of his character, will, and fighting instincts.
"Little guy, he finally got through it." Ye Lixi murmured in a low voice.
From the beginning, the blood was weak and the whole island wasFrom ridiculing useless people, to polishing his body step by step, tempering his Qi and blood, awakening his talents, and purifying strange things, he has survived countless cold looks, doubts, and life-and-death crises, and today he finally stands at the top of the Huangxi Island Martial Arts College Entrance Examination.
On the stage.
Cai Yiyi slowly calmed down the boiling blood all over her body and walked step by step towards the edge of the ring.
When passing by Jia Heimi, she paused slightly and said calmly, "You are very strong" in her cold voice without any hint of victory or defeat.
This was the first time she took the initiative to recognize an opponent at the same level.
In the past, she regarded all her peers as mediocre people, and she followed the path of martial arts independently. No one could force her to go all out, and no one could make her feel afraid.
Jia Heimi raised his eyes, wiped the cold sweat from his forehead, and smiled: "It's just a fluke, you kept it."
He could clearly sense that in the last moment of the duel, the opponent's bloodline kill could fall at any time, but in the end he chose to restrain his offensive and defaulted to a draw.
Cai Yiyi looked at him sideways, her eyes clear: "Martial arts duel, the outcome is the most important. A draw is the strength of you and me today."
After saying that, she said no more, turned around and walked off the stage, her back looking cold and aloof, but without any condescending arrogance.
After this battle, the two geniuses of Huangxi Island were completely equal in reputation.
In the center of the arena, all the qualified candidates lined up in sequence, and the peak showdown that had just ended was completely overturned.
The martial arts college entrance examination finals, which had been delayed for many days, finally came to a successful conclusion after being infiltrated by evil spirits, conspiracy in the exam room, thorough investigation by the alliance, and turbulent situations.
Next, comes the most nervous and anticipated part for all candidates - the announcement of the overall results and the start of admission to prestigious schools.
The ranking rules for the martial arts college entrance examination have never been based solely on actual combat results.
